title: Sentry MCP Server
summary: Connect your agent to Sentry's hosted MCP server to read issues, stack traces and events for a project and fix the bug behind an alert.
description: Sentry hosts an official MCP server that exposes your organization's issues and events to the agent. Instead of pasting a stack trace, you ask about an issue and the agent reads the trace, the release and the affected users itself.
Sign-in uses OAuth, so there is no token to store. Scope the URL to one organization and project to keep the agent focused.
useWhen: Fix the bug behind a fresh Sentry alert
Find the newest unresolved issues in one project
See which release introduced an error
Summarize an issue with its stack trace and tags

mcp.name: sentry
access: Reads issues, events and projects in your Sentry account after you sign in
Authenticates with OAuth; no token is stored in the config

example.prompt: Show the three most frequent unresolved issues in the web project and find the cause of the top one.
example.result: Top issue: TypeError reading "id" of undefined in CartSummary, 412 events since release 2.8.1. The trace points to src/cart/summary.tsx:57 where the cart can be null after logout.

faq.question: How do I limit it to one project?
faq.answer: Append the organization and project slugs to the URL, for example /mcp/my-org/my-project.

faq.question: Where do I sign in?
faq.answer: The first connection opens an OAuth flow in your browser. In Claude Code, run /mcp to start it.

access: Reads Sentry issues and events you can access
